// Uno_Mas

//@version=6

// ============================================================================
// VWAP SESSION AND NY CASH
// ============================================================================
//
// OVERVIEW:
// This indicator displays two Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) lines designed
// specifically for US equity markets:
//
//   1. NY VWAP (Cash Session VWAP) - Calculates VWAP for regular trading hours
//      only (9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET). Resets daily at market open.
//
//   2. Session VWAP - Calculates VWAP for the full trading session including
//      pre-market and after-hours (6:00 PM - 4:00 PM ET next day). Only displays
//      when extended hours data is available on the chart.
//
// The Session VWAP also supports standard deviation bands for identifying
// potential support/resistance levels.
//
// ============================================================================

indicator("VWAP Session and NY Cash", overlay = true)

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================
// Time session definitions (America/New_York timezone)
const string TIMEZONE           = "America/New_York"
const string EXTENDED_SESSION   = "1800-0929"  // Extended hours: 6:00 PM to 9:29 AM
const string MARKET_SESSION     = "0930-1600"  // Regular market: 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM
const string IB_SESSION         = "0930-1030"  // Initial Balance: first hour

// Fully transparent color for label backgrounds
transparent = color.rgb(0, 0, 0, 100)

// ============================================================================
// USER INPUTS
// ============================================================================

// Calculation Settings
CALC_GROUP = "Calculation"
i_enableHD = input.bool(true, title = "Use 5-min data for precision", group = CALC_GROUP, tooltip = "On chart timeframes above 5 minutes, calculate VWAP using 5-minute bars for more accurate values. Prevents VWAP drift on higher timeframe charts.")
i_debugLog = input.bool(false, title = "Debug Logging", group = CALC_GROUP, tooltip = "Enable logging to Pine Logs for debugging. Logs every 30 minutes.")

// NY Cash VWAP Settings
NY_GROUP = "NY VWAP"
i_NY_color          = input.color(color.new(#4caf50, 0), title = "Color", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_NY_width          = input.int(1, title = "Width", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_NY_style          = input.string("Solid", title = "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = NY_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_NY_showlabel      = input.bool(true, title = "Show Label", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_NY_label          = input.string("NYVWAP", title = "", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_NY_labelOffset    = input.int(0, title = "Offset", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_NY_txtSize        = str.lower(input.string("Normal", title = "Label Size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group = NY_GROUP))
i_NY_showPriceScale = input.bool(true, title = "Show in Price Scale", group = NY_GROUP)

// NY Open & IB Settings
NY_OPEN_GROUP = "NY Open & Initial Balance"
i_showNYOpen      = input.bool(true, "Show NY Open", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP)
i_nyOpenColor     = input.color(color.gray, "Open Color", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "open")
i_nyOpenStyle     = input.string("Dashed", "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "open")
i_showNYOpenLabel = input.bool(true, "Show Label", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "open_lab")
i_nyOpenLabelText = input.string("NY Open", "", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "open_lab")

i_showIB          = input.bool(true, "Show Initial Balance (IB)", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP)
i_ibColor         = input.color(color.new(#5b9cf6, 0), "IB Color", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib")
i_ibStyle         = input.string("Solid", "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib")
i_ibWidth         = input.int(1, "Width", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib")
i_showIBLabel     = input.bool(true, "Show Labels", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib_lab")
i_ibHighLabelText = input.string("IB High", "", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib_lab")
i_ibLowLabelText  = input.string("IB Low", "", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib_lab")
i_openIBLabOffset = input.int(0, "Label Offset", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP)

// Session VWAP Settings
SESSION_GROUP = "Session VWAP"
i_Session_enabled        = input.bool(true, title = "Enabled", group = SESSION_GROUP, tooltip = "Disable to skip Session VWAP calculation and rendering. Useful when using the built-in VWAP indicator separately.")
i_Session_color          = input.color(color.new(#04eb85, 0), title = "Color", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_Session_width          = input.int(2, title = "Width", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_Session_style          = input.string("Dashed", title = "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_Session_showlabel      = input.bool(true, title = "Show Label", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_Session_label          = input.string("VWAP", title = "", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_Session_labelOffset    = input.int(0, title = "Offset", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_Session_txtSize        = str.lower(input.string("Normal", title = "Label Size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group = SESSION_GROUP))
i_Session_showPriceScale = input.bool(true, title = "Show in Price Scale", group = SESSION_GROUP)

// Session VWAP Bands Settings
BANDS_GROUP = "Session VWAP Bands"
i_showBand1       = input.bool(false, title = "Band Std Dev #1", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1a")
i_bandMult1       = input.float(1.0, title = "", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1a", step = 0.5, minval = 0)
i_bandStyle1      = input.string("Solid", title = "", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1a")
i_bandColor1      = input.color(color.new(color.green, 0), title = "Line", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1b")
i_bandFill1       = input.color(color.new(color.green, 90), title = "Fill", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1b")
i_bandPriceScale1 = input.bool(false, title = "Price Scale", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1b")

i_showBand2       = input.bool(false, title = "Band Std Dev #2", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2a")
i_bandMult2       = input.float(2.0, title = "", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2a", step = 0.5, minval = 0)
i_bandStyle2      = input.string("Solid", title = "", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2a")
i_bandColor2      = input.color(color.new(color.olive, 0), title = "Line", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2b")
i_bandFill2       = input.color(color.new(color.olive, 90), title = "Fill", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2b")
i_bandPriceScale2 = input.bool(false, title = "Price Scale", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2b")

i_showBand3       = input.bool(false, title = "Band Std Dev #3", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3a")
i_bandMult3       = input.float(3.0, title = "", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3a", step = 0.5, minval = 0)
i_bandStyle3      = input.string("Solid", title = "", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3a")
i_bandColor3      = input.color(color.new(color.teal, 0), title = "Line", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3b")
i_bandFill3       = input.color(color.new(color.teal, 90), title = "Fill", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3b")
i_bandPriceScale3 = input.bool(false, title = "Price Scale", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3b")

// ============================================================================
// USER DEFINED TYPE
// ============================================================================
type myVWAP
    label lab
    int lab_offset
    bool isActive = true
    float cumPV = 0.0
    float cumVol = 0.0
    float vwap = na

// ============================================================================
// STATE VARIABLES
// ============================================================================

// Session VWAP - tracks full trading day (including extended hours)
var myVWAP sessionVWAP = myVWAP.new(
     label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = color.new(i_Session_color, 0), size = i_Session_txtSize),
     i_Session_labelOffset
 )

// Cash VWAP uses two alternating instances to handle the market open transition smoothly.
// When market opens, we swap which VWAP is "active" - the inactive one continues displaying
// the previous day's VWAP while the active one calculates the new day's VWAP.
// This prevents visual discontinuities at market open.
// Note: Each cash VWAP has its own label for independent control
var myVWAP cashVWAP1 = myVWAP.new(
     label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = color.new(i_NY_color, 0), size = i_NY_txtSize),
     i_NY_labelOffset
 )

var myVWAP cashVWAP2 = myVWAP.new(
     label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = color.new(i_NY_color, 0), size = i_NY_txtSize),
     i_NY_labelOffset,
     isActive = false
 )

// NY Open and IB Variables
var float nyOpenPrice = na
var float ibHigh = na
var float ibLow = na

// NY Open and IB Labels
var label nyOpenLab = label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_nyOpenColor, size = size.normal)
var label ibHighLab = label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_ibColor, size = size.normal)
var label ibLowLab  = label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_ibColor, size = size.normal)

// Display configurations
var sessionVWAPdisplay = i_Session_showPriceScale ? display.pane + display.data_window + display.status_line + display.price_scale : display.pane + display.data_window + display.status_line

// Note: This display config excludes display.pane because we have separate plots for cashVWAP1/cashVWAP2 that handle pane display
var cashVWAPdisplay = i_NY_showPriceScale ? display.data_window + display.status_line + display.price_scale : display.data_window + display.status_line

// Tracks which cash VWAP instance (1 or 2) is currently active
var int activeCashVWAP = 1

// Whether to show session VWAP (only shown if extended hours data exists)
var bool showSessionVWAP = false

// First run flag for initialization
var bool firstRun = true

// Tracks if we've detected extended hours candles (used to determine if session VWAP should be displayed)
var bool hasExtendedHoursData = false

// Session VWAP Band values
var float upperBand1 = na
var float lowerBand1 = na
var float upperBand2 = na
var float lowerBand2 = na
var float upperBand3 = na
var float lowerBand3 = na

// ============================================================================
// VWAP FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

// Resets VWAP cumulative values to start fresh calculation
resetVWAP(myVWAP vwap) =>
    vwap.cumPV := 0.0
    vwap.cumVol := 0.0
    vwap.vwap := 0.0

// Updates VWAP calculation with current bar's data
updateVWAP(myVWAP vwap, bool showLabel, string labelText) =>
    if vwap.isActive
        vwap.cumPV += hlc3 * volume
        vwap.cumVol += volume
        vwap.vwap := vwap.cumVol > 0 ? vwap.cumPV / vwap.cumVol : na

        vwap.lab.set_x(bar_index + vwap.lab_offset)
        vwap.lab.set_y(vwap.vwap)
        vwap.lab.set_text(showLabel ? labelText : "")
        vwap.lab.set_tooltip(showLabel ? str.tostring(vwap.vwap, format.mintick) : "")

// Calculates VWAP using built-in ta.vwap for higher timeframes (daily/weekly)
calcHigherTimeframeVWAP(myVWAP vwap, simple string vwapPeriod, bool showLabel, string labelText) =>
    vwap.vwap := ta.vwap(hlc3, timeframe.change(vwapPeriod))
    vwap.lab.set_x(bar_index + vwap.lab_offset)
    vwap.lab.set_y(vwap.vwap)
    vwap.lab.set_text(showLabel ? labelText : "")
    vwap.lab.set_tooltip(showLabel ? str.tostring(vwap.vwap, format.mintick) : "")

// HD Mode helper: Detect if current bar is the first bar at or after 9:30 AM (market open)
f_isMarketOpen5min() =>
    h = hour(time, TIMEZONE)
    m = minute(time, TIMEZONE)
    ph = hour(time[1], TIMEZONE)
    pm = minute(time[1], TIMEZONE)
    // Current bar is exactly 9:30, OR current bar is after 9:30 and previous was before
    currAt930 = (h == 9 and m == 30)
    currAfter930 = h > 9 or (h == 9 and m >= 30)
    prevBefore930 = ph < 9 or (ph == 9 and pm < 30)
    currAt930 or (currAfter930 and prevBefore930)

// HD Mode helper: Detect if current bar is within market hours (9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET)
f_inMarketHours() =>
    h = hour(time, TIMEZONE)
    m = minute(time, TIMEZONE)
    afterOpen = h > 9 or (h == 9 and m >= 30)
    beforeClose = h < 16
    afterOpen and beforeClose

// ============================================================================
// VOLUME VALIDATION
// ============================================================================
cumVolume = ta.cum(volume)
if barstate.islast and cumVolume == 0
    runtime.error("No volume is provided by the data vendor.")

// ============================================================================
// SESSION DETECTION
// ============================================================================
bool isExtendedSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, EXTENDED_SESSION, TIMEZONE))
bool isMarketSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, MARKET_SESSION, TIMEZONE))
bool isMarketOpen = isMarketSession and (isMarketSession != isMarketSession[1])
bool isIBPeriod = not na(time(timeframe.period, IB_SESSION, TIMEZONE))

// ============================================================================
// MAIN LOGIC
// ============================================================================

// First run initialization
if firstRun
    firstRun := false
    if timeframe.isdaily or timeframe.isweekly
        // Delete cash VWAP labels on daily/weekly (not applicable)
        label.delete(cashVWAP1.lab)
        label.delete(cashVWAP2.lab)
        label.delete(nyOpenLab)
        label.delete(ibHighLab)
        label.delete(ibLowLab)
    // Delete session VWAP label if disabled
    if not i_Session_enabled
        label.delete(sessionVWAP.lab)

// Handle different timeframes
if timeframe.isdaily
    // Daily chart: use weekly VWAP anchor
    if i_Session_enabled
        calcHigherTimeframeVWAP(sessionVWAP, "1W", i_Session_showlabel, i_Session_label)

else if timeframe.isweekly
    // Weekly chart: use monthly VWAP anchor
    if i_Session_enabled
        calcHigherTimeframeVWAP(sessionVWAP, "1M", i_Session_showlabel, i_Session_label)

else if timeframe.isintraday
    // Intraday chart: calculate custom VWAPs

    // Fix for commodities to properly flag session end
    // session.islastbar_regular detects the last bar of regular trading hours
    if session.islastbar_regular
        isMarketSession := false

    // Determine if HD mode should be used
    // HD mode: for timeframes > 5min but < 1D, use 5min data for more precision
    chartMinutes = timeframe.in_seconds() / 60
    useHD = i_enableHD and chartMinutes > 5 and chartMinutes < 1440  // 1440 = 24 hours

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // NY Open & IB Logic
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if isMarketOpen
        nyOpenPrice := open
        ibHigh := high
        ibLow := low
    else if isIBPeriod
        ibHigh := math.max(nz(ibHigh, -1e10), high)
        ibLow := math.min(nz(ibLow, 1e10), low)

    // Update NY Open and IB Labels
    if not na(nyOpenPrice) and i_showNYOpen and i_showNYOpenLabel
        nyOpenLab.set_xy(bar_index + i_openIBLabOffset, nyOpenPrice)
        nyOpenLab.set_text(i_nyOpenLabelText)
        nyOpenLab.set_textcolor(i_nyOpenColor)
    else
        nyOpenLab.set_text("")

    if not na(ibHigh) and i_showIB and i_showIBLabel
        ibHighLab.set_xy(bar_index + i_openIBLabOffset, ibHigh)
        ibHighLab.set_text(i_ibHighLabelText)
        ibHighLab.set_textcolor(i_ibColor)
    else
        ibHighLab.set_text("")

    if not na(ibLow) and i_showIB and i_showIBLabel
        ibLowLab.set_xy(bar_index + i_openIBLabOffset, ibLow)
        ibLowLab.set_text(i_ibLowLabelText)
        ibLowLab.set_textcolor(i_ibColor)
    else
        ibLowLab.set_text("")

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Cash VWAP Logic
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    // Day counter for logging (incremented at each 9:30 reset)
    var int dayCounter = 0
    
    // For HD NY VWAP: Request raw data from 5-min bars (only when useHD is true)
    // When chart is 5-min or less, we use regular calculation instead
    var float[] pvArray_hd = array.new_float(0)
    var float[] volArray_hd = array.new_float(0)
    var int lastResetDay_hd = -1
    float nyVwapHD = na
    
    if useHD
        // Request all data in a single call using tuple (more efficient than 3 separate calls)
        [hlc3Array, volArray, timeArray] = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "5", [hlc3, volume, time])
        
        // Process each intrabar from the current chart bar
        if array.size(hlc3Array) > 0
            for i = 0 to array.size(hlc3Array) - 1
                barTime = array.get(timeArray, i)
                barHlc3 = array.get(hlc3Array, i)
                barVol = array.get(volArray, i)
                
                h = hour(barTime, TIMEZONE)
                m = minute(barTime, TIMEZONE)
                d = dayofmonth(barTime, TIMEZONE)
                
                // Check if this is a 9:30 bar (market open)
                is930 = (h == 9 and m == 30)
                
                if is930 and d != lastResetDay_hd
                    // Reset arrays at first 9:30 bar of each day
                    dayCounter += 1
                    if i_debugLog
                        log.info("Day {0} | === RESET at 9:30 === | clearing pvArray size: {1}", 
                                 dayCounter, array.size(pvArray_hd))
                    array.clear(pvArray_hd)
                    array.clear(volArray_hd)
                    lastResetDay_hd := d
                
                if barVol > 0
                    // Accumulate all bars (24/7), reset only at 9:30
                    array.push(pvArray_hd, barHlc3 * barVol)
                    array.push(volArray_hd, barVol)
            
            // Calculate VWAP from accumulated arrays
            if array.size(pvArray_hd) > 0
                float totalPV = array.sum(pvArray_hd)
                float totalVol = array.sum(volArray_hd)
                nyVwapHD := totalVol > 0 ? totalPV / totalVol : na
        
        // Log chart bar summary (every 30 mins when debug enabled)
        if i_debugLog
            int chartBarHour = hour(time, TIMEZONE)
            int chartBarMinute = minute(time, TIMEZONE)
            bool shouldLog = (chartBarMinute == 0 or chartBarMinute == 30)
            
            if shouldLog
                string vwapStr = na(nyVwapHD) ? "NA" : str.tostring(nyVwapHD, "#.##")
                log.info("Day {0} | ChartBar {1}:{2} | nyVwapHD: {3} | pvArraySize: {4} | intrabars: {5}", 
                         dayCounter, chartBarHour, str.tostring(chartBarMinute, "00"), 
                         vwapStr, array.size(pvArray_hd), array.size(hlc3Array))
    
    if isMarketOpen
        // Increment day counter (for both HD and non-HD modes)
        if not useHD
            dayCounter += 1
        
        // At market open, swap active VWAP instance
        // This allows the previous day's VWAP to remain visible briefly
        // while the new day's VWAP begins calculating
        if activeCashVWAP == 1
            activeCashVWAP := 2
            cashVWAP1.isActive := false
            cashVWAP2.isActive := true
            // Clear inactive label
            cashVWAP1.lab.set_text("")
            cashVWAP1.lab.set_tooltip("")
            resetVWAP(cashVWAP2)
            if useHD and not na(nyVwapHD)
                cashVWAP2.vwap := nyVwapHD
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_x(bar_index + cashVWAP2.lab_offset)
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_y(cashVWAP2.vwap)
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_text(i_NY_showlabel ? i_NY_label : "")
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_tooltip(i_NY_showlabel ? str.tostring(cashVWAP2.vwap, format.mintick) : "")
            else
                updateVWAP(cashVWAP2, i_NY_showlabel, i_NY_label)
        else
            activeCashVWAP := 1
            cashVWAP1.isActive := true
            cashVWAP2.isActive := false
            // Clear inactive label
            cashVWAP2.lab.set_text("")
            cashVWAP2.lab.set_tooltip("")
            resetVWAP(cashVWAP1)
            if useHD and not na(nyVwapHD)
                cashVWAP1.vwap := nyVwapHD
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_x(bar_index + cashVWAP1.lab_offset)
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_y(cashVWAP1.vwap)
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_text(i_NY_showlabel ? i_NY_label : "")
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_tooltip(i_NY_showlabel ? str.tostring(cashVWAP1.vwap, format.mintick) : "")
            else
                updateVWAP(cashVWAP1, i_NY_showlabel, i_NY_label)
    else
        // Normal update for both (only active one will actually update)
        if useHD and not na(nyVwapHD)
            // In HD mode, use the calculated HD value (24/7, not just market hours)
            if cashVWAP1.isActive
                cashVWAP1.vwap := nyVwapHD
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_x(bar_index + cashVWAP1.lab_offset)
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_y(cashVWAP1.vwap)
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_text(i_NY_showlabel ? i_NY_label : "")
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_tooltip(i_NY_showlabel ? str.tostring(cashVWAP1.vwap, format.mintick) : "")
            else
                cashVWAP2.vwap := nyVwapHD
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_x(bar_index + cashVWAP2.lab_offset)
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_y(cashVWAP2.vwap)
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_text(i_NY_showlabel ? i_NY_label : "")
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_tooltip(i_NY_showlabel ? str.tostring(cashVWAP2.vwap, format.mintick) : "")
        else
            updateVWAP(cashVWAP1, i_NY_showlabel, i_NY_label)
            updateVWAP(cashVWAP2, i_NY_showlabel, i_NY_label)
    
    // Debug logging for 5min chart (non-HD mode)
    if i_debugLog and not useHD
        int chartBarHour = hour(time, TIMEZONE)
        int chartBarMinute = minute(time, TIMEZONE)
        bool shouldLog = (chartBarMinute == 0 or chartBarMinute == 30)
        
        if shouldLog
            float activeVwap = cashVWAP1.isActive ? cashVWAP1.vwap : cashVWAP2.vwap
            string vwapStr = na(activeVwap) ? "NA" : str.tostring(activeVwap, "#.##")
            log.info("Day {0} | 5min | ChartBar {1}:{2} | nyVWAP: {3}", 
                     dayCounter, chartBarHour, str.tostring(chartBarMinute, "00"), vwapStr)

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Session VWAP Logic (only if enabled)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if i_Session_enabled
        // Check for extended session candles to determine if session VWAP should be shown
        // Only enable session VWAP if the chart includes extended hours data
        if isExtendedSession and not hasExtendedHoursData
            hasExtendedHoursData := true
            showSessionVWAP := true

    // Session VWAP anchor: timeframe.change("1D") resets at 18:00 ET for futures/extended hours
    isNewDay = timeframe.change("1D")
    
    // Standard calculation on current timeframe
    [vwapStd, stdevUpperStd, _stdevLowerStd] = ta.vwap(hlc3, isNewDay, 1)
    stdevAbsStd = stdevUpperStd - vwapStd
    
    // HD calculation from 5min timeframe (only when useHD is true)
    float vwapHD = na
    float stdevAbsHD = na
    
    if useHD
        // Returns arrays - get the last value from each
        vwapHDArray = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "5", ta.vwap(hlc3, timeframe.change("1D")))
        vwapHD := array.size(vwapHDArray) > 0 ? array.last(vwapHDArray) : na
        
        // For standard deviation, extract the upper band value from ta.vwap tuple first
        [_vwapForStdev, stdevUpperForHD, _stdevLowerForHD] = ta.vwap(hlc3, timeframe.change("1D"), 1)
        stdevUpperHDArray = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "5", stdevUpperForHD)
        stdevUpperHD = array.size(stdevUpperHDArray) > 0 ? array.last(stdevUpperHDArray) : na
        stdevAbsHD := nz(stdevUpperHD) - nz(vwapHD)
    
    // Select which values to use based on HD mode
    vwapVal = useHD ? vwapHD : vwapStd
    stdevAbs = useHD ? stdevAbsHD : stdevAbsStd
    
    // Only update if Session VWAP is enabled and should be shown
    if i_Session_enabled and showSessionVWAP
        sessionVWAP.vwap := vwapVal
        
        // Update label
        sessionVWAP.lab.set_x(bar_index + sessionVWAP.lab_offset)
        sessionVWAP.lab.set_y(sessionVWAP.vwap)
        sessionVWAP.lab.set_text(i_Session_showlabel ? i_Session_label : "")
        sessionVWAP.lab.set_tooltip(i_Session_showlabel ? str.tostring(sessionVWAP.vwap, format.mintick) : "")

    // Calculate band values (standard deviation based) - these need to be outside if block
    showBands = i_Session_enabled and showSessionVWAP and not session.islastbar
    upperBand1 := showBands ? vwapVal + stdevAbs * i_bandMult1 : na
    lowerBand1 := showBands ? vwapVal - stdevAbs * i_bandMult1 : na
    upperBand2 := showBands ? vwapVal + stdevAbs * i_bandMult2 : na
    lowerBand2 := showBands ? vwapVal - stdevAbs * i_bandMult2 : na
    upperBand3 := showBands ? vwapVal + stdevAbs * i_bandMult3 : na
    lowerBand3 := showBands ? vwapVal - stdevAbs * i_bandMult3 : na

// ============================================================================
// PLOTS
// ============================================================================

// Linestyles from inputs
sessionLinestyle = i_Session_style == "Solid" ? plot.linestyle_solid : i_Session_style == "Dashed" ? plot.linestyle_dashed : plot.linestyle_dotted
nyLinestyle = i_NY_style == "Solid" ? plot.linestyle_solid : i_NY_style == "Dashed" ? plot.linestyle_dashed : plot.linestyle_dotted
nyOpenLinestyle = i_nyOpenStyle == "Solid" ? plot.linestyle_solid : i_nyOpenStyle == "Dashed" ? plot.linestyle_dashed : plot.linestyle_dotted
ibLinestyle = i_ibStyle == "Solid" ? plot.linestyle_solid : i_ibStyle == "Dashed" ? plot.linestyle_dashed : plot.linestyle_dotted

// NY Open & IB Plots
plot(i_showNYOpen and isMarketSession ? nyOpenPrice : na, "NY Open", i_nyOpenColor, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = nyOpenLinestyle)
plot(i_showIB and isMarketSession ? ibHigh : na, "IB High", i_ibColor, i_ibWidth, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = ibLinestyle)
plot(i_showIB and isMarketSession ? ibLow : na, "IB Low", i_ibColor, i_ibWidth, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = ibLinestyle)

// Session VWAP - full trading session including extended hours
sessionVwapValue = i_Session_enabled ? sessionVWAP.vwap : na
plot(sessionVwapValue, title = "Session VWAP", color = i_Session_color, linewidth = i_Session_width, style = plot.style_linebr, display = sessionVWAPdisplay, linestyle = sessionLinestyle)

// Session VWAP Bands
// Linestyles for bands
bandLinestyle1 = i_bandStyle1 == "Solid" ? plot.linestyle_solid : i_bandStyle1 == "Dashed" ? plot.linestyle_dashed : plot.linestyle_dotted
bandLinestyle2 = i_bandStyle2 == "Solid" ? plot.linestyle_solid : i_bandStyle2 == "Dashed" ? plot.linestyle_dashed : plot.linestyle_dotted
bandLinestyle3 = i_bandStyle3 == "Solid" ? plot.linestyle_solid : i_bandStyle3 == "Dashed" ? plot.linestyle_dashed : plot.linestyle_dotted

// Display settings for each band (pane only, plus price scale if enabled)
// Bands are hidden from data window and status line to reduce clutter
displayBand1 = i_showBand1 and i_Session_enabled ? (i_bandPriceScale1 ? display.pane + display.price_scale : display.pane) : display.none
displayBand2 = i_showBand2 and i_Session_enabled ? (i_bandPriceScale2 ? display.pane + display.price_scale : display.pane) : display.none
displayBand3 = i_showBand3 and i_Session_enabled ? (i_bandPriceScale3 ? display.pane + display.price_scale : display.pane) : display.none

// Fill display only supports display.all or display.none
fillDisplayBand1 = i_showBand1 and i_Session_enabled ? display.all : display.none
fillDisplayBand2 = i_showBand2 and i_Session_enabled ? display.all : display.none
fillDisplayBand3 = i_showBand3 and i_Session_enabled ? display.all : display.none

upperBand1Plot = plot(upperBand1, title = "Upper Band 1SD", color = i_bandColor1, style = plot.style_linebr, display = displayBand1, linestyle = bandLinestyle1)
lowerBand1Plot = plot(lowerBand1, title = "Lower Band 1SD", color = i_bandColor1, style = plot.style_linebr, display = displayBand1, linestyle = bandLinestyle1)
fill(upperBand1Plot, lowerBand1Plot, title = "Band 1SD Fill", color = i_bandFill1, display = fillDisplayBand1)

upperBand2Plot = plot(upperBand2, title = "Upper Band 2SD", color = i_bandColor2, style = plot.style_linebr, display = displayBand2, linestyle = bandLinestyle2)
lowerBand2Plot = plot(lowerBand2, title = "Lower Band 2SD", color = i_bandColor2, style = plot.style_linebr, display = displayBand2, linestyle = bandLinestyle2)
fill(upperBand2Plot, lowerBand2Plot, title = "Band 2SD Fill", color = i_bandFill2, display = fillDisplayBand2)

upperBand3Plot = plot(upperBand3, title = "Upper Band 3SD", color = i_bandColor3, style = plot.style_linebr, display = displayBand3, linestyle = bandLinestyle3)
lowerBand3Plot = plot(lowerBand3, title = "Lower Band 3SD", color = i_bandColor3, style = plot.style_linebr, display = displayBand3, linestyle = bandLinestyle3)
fill(upperBand3Plot, lowerBand3Plot, title = "Band 3SD Fill", color = i_bandFill3, display = fillDisplayBand3)

// Cash VWAP - displays the currently active VWAP value (for data window/status line/price scale)
cashVwapValue = cashVWAP1.isActive ? cashVWAP1.vwap : cashVWAP2.vwap
plot(cashVwapValue, title = "Cash VWAP", color = i_NY_color, linewidth = i_NY_width, style = plot.style_linebr, display = cashVWAPdisplay, linestyle = nyLinestyle)

// Separate plots for each cash VWAP instance on the pane
// This ensures smooth visual transitions when swapping active VWAP at market open
cashVwap1Value = cashVWAP1.isActive ? cashVWAP1.vwap : na
cashVwap2Value = cashVWAP2.isActive ? cashVWAP2.vwap : na

plot(cashVwap1Value, title = "Cash VWAP1", color = i_NY_color, linewidth = i_NY_width, style = plot.style_linebr, display = display.pane, linestyle = nyLinestyle)
plot(cashVwap2Value, title = "Cash VWAP2", color = i_NY_color, linewidth = i_NY_width, style = plot.style_linebr, display = display.pane, linestyle = nyLinestyle)
